textLayerOnlyCorroboration.textLayer: Drow can speak the common tongue, the language of “undercom- mon” (a trade language of those who dwell beneath the earth), p’rus

the elvish and gnomish languages, as well as other languages up to the limit prescribed by intelligence score. In addition, all dark elves “speak” the silent tongue of subterranean dwellers, a language of complex hand signals and gestures, combined with facial expres- sions and body language. The range of communication in this silent tongue is only 30’, but it is as informative as any other language within that range. Only the drow may fully master this tongue, though other races may be taught its basic signs and symbols.
